findings.description: Positional-fallback emitted PHP 8.4 'undefined array key' warning under behat --strict; fixed via null-coalescing (behavior preserved).

findings.description: getType() contract lacked union/intersection/nullable coverage; added rows (15 tests/39 assertions).

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO
findings.description: Frontmatter verified:true contradicted the 'not yet runtime-verified' checkpoint note; replaced with verified status.

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO
findings.description: Widened instanceof + first-match break could bind scope to the wrong parameter if a hook declares two object-typed params (first a parent/interface the scope satisfies). Contrived but a behavior change. Fix: exact-name match before instanceof, or document first-assignable-wins.

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO
findings.description: parameterAcceptsScope() is the only typed method in an otherwise phpdoc-only untyped file. Either type the two edited public methods too, or revert helper to phpdoc-only.

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO
findings.description: Declares two top-level fixture types inline (no repo precedent; soft PSR-4/one-class-per-file smell). Move to a dedicated fixtures file or reuse real Behat scope classes.

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO
findings.description: ProphecyTrait placement differs from the other two prophecy tests; align as first class member + blank line.

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO

findings.author: MIGUEL ANGEL GARZON MALDONADO
findings.description: composer audit on a lock-free library is non-deterministic over time (green today can go red tomorrow with no code change). Informational; acceptable for a test tool.
